en: The image is an illustrated or painted postcard showing a picturesque riverside city with historic multi-story buildings lined up along a waterfront. Above the buildings, on a wooded hill, there is a large castle or fortress complex, characterized by stone walls and towers. The lower part of the image features a bridge and a river, while the sky is painted in a yellowish tone, suggesting either a vintage artistic style or a sunset/sunrise ambiance.
